       - Update `sum[i + 1]` to be `sum[i] + cnt`.
    8. Iterate over the range `n`, and for each index `i`, if `push[i]` is greater than or equal to 0, add `sum[q] - sum[push[i]]` to `ans[i]`.

    10. Print the constructed string from the StringBuilder to standard output.

fix_specification_reasoning.intended_behavior: The function is intended to process a sequence of queries on an integer array A of length N, initially filled with zeros. Each query involves an integer x_i. If x_i is in a set S, it should be removed; otherwise, it should be added to S. After processing each query, for every index j in the array A that is also in S, the size of S (|S|) should be added to A[j]. The goal is to determine the final values of the array A after all queries have been processed.
fix_specification_reasoning.diagnosis_and_repair_directions: The flawed specification incorrectly calculates the value to add to the array A when an element is removed from the set S. The calculation `v = sum[i] - push[x]` is incorrect because it does not correctly account for the cumulative effect of adding |S| to the elements of A. Instead, the function should track the cumulative sum of |S| over the iterations and correctly update A when elements are added or removed from S. The logic for updating the array A when an element is removed from S should be revised to correctly reflect the intended behavior.

The function is intended to process a sequence of queries on an integer array A of length N, initially filled with zeros. Each query involves an integer x_i. If x_i is in a set S, it should be removed; otherwise, it should be added to S. After processing each query, for every index j in the array A that is also in S, the size of S (|S|) should be added to A[j]. The goal is to determine the final values of the array A after all queries have been processed.

Diagnosis and Repair Directions:
The flawed specification incorrectly calculates the value to add to the array A when an element is removed from the set S. The calculation `v = sum[i] - push[x]` is incorrect because it does not correctly account for the cumulative effect of adding |S| to the elements of A. Instead, the function should track the cumulative sum of |S| over the iterations and correctly update A when elements are added or removed from S. The logic for updating the array A when an element is removed from S should be revised to correctly reflect the intended behavior.
